summary: Iter9 — verified 3 features end-to-end: (1) Dashboard walk-ins removal, (2) Cohort drill-down drawer + bulk-task dialog, (3) Social platforms card with Instagram/X/TikTok/Snapchat connect/disconnect flow. Backend 12/12 pytest green; frontend Playwright run for all required selectors green; round-tripped a real connect/disconnect against the live API.

issues: Recharts emits 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on first paint before tab becomes visible (tier-flow-chart inside hidden tab). Cosmetic only — chart renders correctly once Cohorts tab is visible.
DialogContent missing aria-describedby — a11y warning surfaced in console. Add a DialogDescription to silence (low priority).

verified_acceptance_criteria: Dashboard: data-testid='walkins-card' is NOT in the DOM. Regression: call-list + follow-ups (tasks-empty/tasks-list) still render. PASS.
Cohorts: 9 cohort-row-{YYYY-MM} rows render; cohort-open-{cohort} and cohort-cell-{cohort}-m1|m3|m6|m12 are buttons; clicking either opens the slide-in drawer (cohort-drill). PASS.
Drill drawer: drill-close, drill-filter-vip|loyal|at_risk|churned|all and drill-customers all present and clickable. PASS.

Bulk-task: drill-bulk-task opens dialog with bulk-task-title + bulk-task-due + bulk-task-submit. Submit fired POST /api/insights/cohorts/bulk-task and the sonner toast read 'Created 1 follow-up'. PASS.

Social tab: data-testid='social-platforms-card' renders below FacebookConnectCard with H3 'Connect Instagram, X, TikTok, Snapchat' and a 4-tile grid (social-platforms-grid) — instagram/x/tiktok/snapchat each with a Connect button (platform-connect-{platform}). PASS.

Connect dialog: clicking platform-connect-instagram opens dialog with platform-token-input + platform-handle-input + platform-connect-submit. Submitting persists the token (POST /api/social/platforms/instagram/connect 200), the tile flips to 'Connected' badge and shows platform-disconnect-instagram trash button. Disconnect (DELETE) restores Connect button. PASS.
Backend GET /api/insights/cohorts/customers — default returns {cohort,count,customers[]}; ?bucket=vip filters all rows to rfm_tier=='vip'; ?bucket=retained_m6 returns 200 for 2023-01. PASS.
Backend POST /api/insights/cohorts/bulk-task — manager 200 with {created,cohort,bucket,title}; associate 403; missing title 422. PASS.
Backend GET /api/social/platforms/status — manager returns 4 platforms with platform/label/scopes/docs_url/token_hint/connected fields; associate 403. PASS.
Backend POST /api/social/platforms/{p}/connect — unknown platform 404; missing access_token 422; valid token persists & GET status reflects connected=true. PASS.
Backend POST /api/social/platforms/{p}/sync — 200 with status='pending_implementation' has_token=true when connected; 400 when not connected. PASS.
Backend DELETE /api/social/platforms/{p} — disconnects, status flips back to connected=false. PASS.
action_items: (Optional, low priority) Add a DialogDescription to bulk-task and platform-connect dialogs to silence aria-describedby a11y warning.
(Optional, cosmetic) Suppress Recharts width/height warning by guarding the BarChart render until the Cohorts tab is in the DOM, or use ResponsiveContainer minWidth/minHeight.
critical_code_review_comments: InsightsTabs.jsx is now ~558 lines — still readable but approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting CohortsTab and OperationsTab into separate files in the next refactor.
ManagerDashboard.jsx contains SocialPlatformsCard + PLATFORM_STYLE map + connect/disconnect logic inline; works fine but a small SocialPlatforms.jsx module would improve testability.

openDrill() in CohortsTab triggers an extra GET /cohorts/customers each time the user changes a filter — correct but no caching. For very large cohorts (e.g. 2025-05 vip) consider memoizing or showing a spinner overlay instead of full loading state to avoid flicker.
runBulkTask() does not optimistic-update or close the drawer after success. UX nicety: refresh /dashboard/me task counters or close drawer to confirm the action.
Social platform Disconnect button has no confirmation dialog — accidental click immediately deletes the token. Recommend a small confirm() or AlertDialog wrapper.
